specs.name: LongestCommonSubsequence_empty_left
specs.stmt: theorem LongestCommonSubsequence_empty_left : ∀ (b : Array Int) (h_precond : LongestCommonSubsequence_precond #[] b), LongestCommonSubsequence #[] b h_precond = 0

specs.name: LongestCommonSubsequence_nonneg
specs.stmt: theorem LongestCommonSubsequence_nonneg : ∀ (a b : Array Int) (h_precond : LongestCommonSubsequence_precond a b), 0 ≤ LongestCommonSubsequence a b h_precond

specs.name: LongestCommonSubsequence_le_left_size
specs.stmt: theorem LongestCommonSubsequence_le_left_size : ∀ (a b : Array Int) (h_precond : LongestCommonSubsequence_precond a b), LongestCommonSubsequence a b h_precond ≤ (a.size : Int)

specs.name: LongestCommonSubsequence_le_right_size
specs.stmt:
∀ (a b : Array Int) (h_precond : LongestCommonSubsequence_precond a b),
    LongestCommonSubsequence a b h_precond ≤ b.size

specs.name: LongestCommonSubsequence_is_maximum
specs.stmt:
∀ (a b : Array Int) (h_precond : LongestCommonSubsequence_precond a b),
    let subseqA := allSubseq a
    let subseqB := allSubseq b
    let commonSubseqLens := subseqA.filter (fun l => subseqB.contains l) |>.map (·.length)
    commonSubseqLens.all (· ≤ LongestCommonSubsequence a b h_precond)

specs.name: LongestCommonSubsequence_symmetric
specs.stmt: theorem LongestCommonSubsequence_symmetric : ∀ (a b : Array Int) (h1 : LongestCommonSubsequence_precond a b) (h2 : LongestCommonSubsequence_precond b a), LongestCommonSubsequence a b h1 = LongestCommonSubsequence b a h2

specs.name: LongestCommonSubsequence_postcond_result
specs.stmt: theorem LongestCommonSubsequence_postcond_result : ∀ (a b : Array Int) (h_precond : LongestCommonSubsequence_precond a b), LongestCommonSubsequence_postcond a b (LongestCommonSubsequence a b h_precond) h_precond

specs.name: LongestCommonSubsequence_empty_subseq_exists
specs.stmt:
∀ (a b : Array Int) (h_precond : LongestCommonSubsequence_precond a b),
    let subseqA := allSubseq a
    let subseqB := allSubseq b
    (subseqA.filter (fun l => subseqB.contains l)).contains []

specs.name: intMax_ge_left
specs.stmt: ∀ (x y : Int), x ≤ intMax x y

specs.name: intMax_eq_or
specs.stmt: ∀ (x y : Int), intMax x y = x ∨ intMax x y = y

specs.name: lcs_nonneg
specs.stmt: theorem lcs_nonneg : ∀ (a b : Array Int) (h : LongestCommonSubsequence_precond a b), 0 ≤ LongestCommonSubsequence a b h

specs.name: lcs_le_min_length
specs.stmt: theorem lcs_le_min_length : ∀ (a b : Array Int) (h : LongestCommonSubsequence_precond a b), LongestCommonSubsequence a b h ≤ min (a.size : Int) (b.size : Int)

specs.name: lcs_symmetric
specs.stmt:
∀ (a b : Array Int)
    (h1 : LongestCommonSubsequence_precond a b)
    (h2 : LongestCommonSubsequence_precond b a),
    LongestCommonSubsequence a b h1 = LongestCommonSubsequence b a h2

specs.name: lcs_intmax_lower_bound
specs.stmt: theorem lcs_intmax_lower_bound : ∀ (x y : Int), x ≤ intMax x y ∧ y ≤ intMax x y

specs.name: lcs_same_second_third
specs.stmt: theorem lcs_same_second_third : LongestCommonSubsequence a b trivial = LongestCommonSubsequence a b trivial

specs.name: lcs_empty_first
specs.stmt: LongestCommonSubsequence #[] b b trivial = LongestCommonSubsequence #[] b b trivial
